semantic_order: kickoff freeze -> first touch -> spread to homes -> one presser + cover -> organic pass

reproduction.wiring: src/apps/browser/main.ts per-slot CPU composition root with CpuObservation.cpuAntiHuddle + cpuDefensiveTackle

cross_runtime_note: Ticks and per-tick hashes are this Chromium run's own; the pinned Node artifacts for the same scenario (docs/evidence/5V5-KICKOFF-ANTI-HUDDLE and docs/evidence/BALL-SETTLED-REGIME-FIX) pin the same arc structure. Per-tick floats are not compared across runtimes (known pinned-runtime gap).

frames.label: kickoff-freeze
frames.description: Kickoff freeze: every body but the kick taker (player-10) holds its fixed kickoff home and the ball sits untouched on the centre spot

frames.label: first-touch
frames.description: First touch: player-10 strikes the frozen kickoff ball, the freeze releases and the ball starts travelling

frames.label: spread-to-homes
frames.description: Spread to homes: the non-chasers still hold their kickoff homes while exactly one designated presser per team moves on the ball

frames.label: press-and-cover
frames.description: One presser + cover: a single designated presser closes on the moving ball with its cover behind it, nobody else converges

frames.label: organic-pass
frames.description: Organic pass: the CPU fired a pass from player-3 at tick 122; by this frame the ball has travelled 2.93 m since it was struck
